ei.title: Grey Squirrels' Impact on Red Squirrels
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. Britain's red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② where → which: 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법 관계대명사
det.analysis:
❌ ① both: 'both squirrel species' — 복수 명사 수식, 정상
✅ ② where → which: 'competed for the same food and habitat, which put ...' — 앞 절 전체를 선행사로 받는 계속적 용법에는 which. where(관계부사)는 장소 선행사 + 완전한 절일 때만 ← 정답
❌ ③ to eat: 'able ... to eat green acorns' — be able to + 원형, 정상
❌ ④ more densely: 'live more densely' — 부사 비교급, 정상
det.tip: , which = 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법. where ≠ 절 전체 지칭

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ has destroyed → has been destroyed: 삼림이 '파괴되는' 수동태
det.analysis:
❌ ① same: 'the same food and habitat' — 정상
❌ ② able: 'it is able to eat' — 정상
✅ ③ has destroyed → has been destroyed: 'when woodland has been destroyed' — 삼림(woodland)은 파괴되는 대상이므로 수동태(has been destroyed) 필요. 능동(has destroyed)은 오류 ← 정답

det.tip: woodland is destroyed = 삼림이 파괴되다 → 현재완료 수동태 has been destroyed

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① more easy → more easily: 동사 survived를 수식하는 부사
det.analysis:
✅ ① more easy → more easily: 'have survived more easily' — 동사 survived를 수식하므로 부사 easily의 비교급(more easily) 필요. 형용사 easy는 오류 ← 정답
❌ ② destroyed: 'has been destroyed' — 수동태 과거분사, 정상
❌ ③ come: 'has come' — 현재완료, 정상

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. Britain's red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for __________, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure.
